verse.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا  إِنَّ مَعَ الْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا

translation: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
reflection: Whatever weighs on you today was never meant to last. Allah repeats His promise twice, so your heart can hold on: ease is already on its way, hidden inside the very hardship you are facing. Keep going, keep praying, and trust that relief is nearer than it feels.
closing: May Allah guide us, strengthen our hearts, and grant us peace. Ameen.
